Alexandra — congratulations again on the signature. As promised, attached is a single-page MAP-oriented orchestration canvas that embeds the post-signature plan: rollout phases, a two-wave canary, migration windows, and the training / enablement cadence.

Highlights (TL;DR):
- Phase 0 (Nov 29–Dec 3): Provisioning & access validation (VPC peering, KMS test keys).
- Phase 1 (Dec 6–Dec 17): Pilot canary (10% traffic, non-critical route), nightly validation jobs + daily sync.
- Phase 2 (Jan 4–Jan 21): Bulk migration and ramp to 80% with throttled batching.
- Training: Two instructor-led sessions (Dec 10, Jan 6), plus on-demand recordings.

Action items for Medisight: confirm the preferred canary windows (overnight vs daytime) and identify the two pilot routes for the initial 10% cutover. We also need a single procurement contact for invoice routing (cc'd procurement alias if you prefer).

Attachments: MAP_Orchestration_Canvas_v1.xlsx (xlsx), Canary_Window_Plan.pdf (pdf), Training_Roster_Template.docx (docx)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a 30-minute runbook walkthrough.

—Tessa

Looping internal owners; responding to Alexandra's question and adding implementation detail for the runbook. Below is a short checklist we should include in the detailed runbook (I’ll convert to the doc before the walkthrough):

Pre-canary (ownership & checks)
- Confirm IAM roles and test tokens (Redwood infra team)
- KMS key rotation test and sample encrypt/decrypt (Security)
- Synthetic query suite (Redwood QA) + expected success thresholds (95th pct latency < 350ms; error rate < 0.5%)
- Baseline model-quality checks (prompt-pair A/B tests against historical set)

Canary execution plan (overnight)
- Window: 02:00–06:00 (PST)
- Traffic split: 10% to canary model variant, 90% to baseline
- Monitoring: token-level latency, per-route error counts, sample output diffing for semantic drift
- Kill-switch: automatic rollback trigger (5 consecutive 1-min windows with error rate > 1%)

Migration & ramp
- Ramp steps: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 80% across two weeks with manual gates at each step
- KV cache warmup job to run pre-ramp (reduce cold-start latencies)

Training & enablement
- Session 1 (Dec 10) — Admins & SREs: runbook walkthrough + incident playbook
- Session 2 (Jan 6) — Product & Ops: model behavior, tuning knobs, cost controls
- Deliverables: runbook PDF, runbook checklist, recording, quick-start scripts

I recommend we propose the walkthrough 30-min slot on Dec 1 or Dec 2 — Tessa, can you propose specific 30-min blocks? I’ll prepare the synthetic suite and thresholds and drop them into HubSpot / shared Drive.

—Ben
